text: The American students Paxton and Josh are backpacking across Europe with their Icelandic friend Óli when a stranger in Amsterdam [promises a hostel near Bratislava full of willing women|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. The hostel delivers until Óli fails to come back and a Japanese visitor shows them a photo of her missing friend. In a factory outside town, [wealthy clients pay to torture and kill travellers|wants|cruelty and destruction], and Paxton wakes [strapped to a chair beside the drills and saws|images|weapons and tools] until a slip of a chainsaw lets him [turn on the men who paid|ending|the guilty are punished].
